title: Art And Architecture: Early Medieval Period (750-1200 AD)
definition: The transition from classical Gupta-Vakataka traditions to regional styles characterized by the rise of temple architecture, complex iconography, and the evolution of Nagara, Dravida, and Vesara styles.
importanceInUpsc: This period marks the crystallization of regional identities in Indian art, frequently tested through architectural features, temple patronage, and stylistic evolution in Prelims and Mains.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Art And Architecture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Gupta period architecture
